workflow.name: Library Book Checkout Workflow
workflow.description: Standard operational workflow for borrowing and inventory adjustment

step.name: Validate Member Status
step.action: Verify member exists and has active standing

step.name: Check Inventory Availability
step.action: Ensure book copy count is greater than zero

step.name: Verify Active Loan Quota
step.action: Ensure member does not exceed maximum 5 active loans

step.name: Create Loan Record
step.action: Insert active loan record with 14-day return window

step.name: Issue Checkout Confirmation
step.action: Finalize checkout and return loan receipt
